notes.title: 《One Day of Romance》📍 is set to launch on Steam on September 12th!
notes.content:

🎐You will transform into a dashing genius, stepping into the opulent scroll of Chang'an Never Sleeps.

In the moonlit night🌃 adorned with flickering lanterns and the fragrant ink in the gallery, gradually unlock fated encounters with multiple peerless beauties, touching the hottest hearts under the gentle breeze and moonlight of the prosperous Tang Dynasty. .....

👇️ [Click to Explore to Unlock the Deadly Flirtatious Bureau]

[list]
[*] Easy Flip Play 🏮: Click on cards that match the same suit or point to eliminate, and level victory directly unlocks the Absolute American Wind Illustration.
